rules.title: Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition/Permanent Removal, Temporary Capital Improvement, or Substantial Rehabilitation Evictions
rules.quote: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.summary: Landlords must pay relocation assistance to tenants evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition, permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, with amounts varying by year and with additional payments for elderly, disabled tenants, or households with minor children.

related_citations.evidence: The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.exemption_note: Temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.citation: S.F. Rent Ordinance (Ellis Act relocation provisions)
rules.quote: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.summary: Landlords must pay relocation assistance to tenants evicted under the Ellis Act, with higher amounts than other no-fault evictions and additional payments for elderly (62+) or disabled tenants.
rules.exemption_note: Ellis Act evictions have higher relocation amounts and elderly threshold is 62 years vs 60 years for other no-fault evictions
